scope: Linux/Xvfb debug, local software/native only; evidence directory date is the task identity, not a claimed run date.
tree_hash_method: Sorted files in lib then shaders: UTF-8 relative path + NUL + SHA256 hex + newline.

provenance.native: run.json baseline identifies HEAD before worker commit; target hash and sources/tree hashes identify tested candidate bytes. Native-tested app/target/driver/wrapper unchanged since run.
provenance.focused: 44 tests including the new real-time budget-branch regression; separate from earlier broad historical suites.
provenance.redaction: driver.log VM-service authentication URL segment redacted; trailing progress-line whitespace removed from driver/analyzer logs. Raw originals remain private.

limits: B128 diagnostics are a separate model pass inside the native process, after the B32 UI/export journey; not B128 UI input-to-ready latency.
Chunk wall time includes preemption but excludes awaited yield; zero-timer waits are separately observed. No 8ms scheduler wakeup guarantee.
Search is synchronous and not cooperatively chunked in current implementation; only generation has the 8ms/1024-probe budget.
RSS/maxRSS cover the complete native debug application including shaders, exports, GC, and instrumentation; no isolated model heap or physical-GPU memory attribution.
GLX probe shares the owned display/environment; it does not independently interrogate the Flutter engine GL context.
No physical accessibility, Android MediaStore/gallery, hardware GPU, browser requalification or human composition acceptance.
